title: Engaging with a few annoyances

This is 4 stars because I HATE with a fiery and deadly passion, being FORCED to watch ads. If I have to watch ads I better be rewarded for it! Eventually, the annoyance of this will result in me deleting the app. I seriously hate ads. I hate commercials and rarely watch streaming services that force that on me. 

I also would like the option to choose the difficulty level rather than having the game ping pong back and forth between levels. 

The positives are the different kinds of art that I'm seeing in different styles and mediums. One thing though: please STOP using AI art! That's such an insult to artists as AI art is basically stolen art from artists who've worked hard to perfect their skill. I doubt you as developers would be thrilled to discover your hard work has been stolen by AI to make a knock off versions.

author: Jules4238
title: Ad-Free Version Please
content:
I’ve really enjoyed this game. The puzzles are relaxing, satisfying, and a fun twist on traditional jigsaw games. It’s become one of those games I keep coming back to.

My biggest complaint is the ads. An ad plays after almost every puzzle, and there isn’t an option to pay to remove them. I don’t mind supporting developers, and I would happily pay for an ad-free version, but that isn’t available. The constant interruptions take away from what is otherwise a great experience.

I’d also love to see additional difficulty levels or more challenging puzzles for players who want a little more variety.

If an ad-free purchase option were added, this would easily be a much higher-rated game for me.

author: Skinnybaker
title: Nice variation
content:
I like this game. No timer. No limit on the number of moves. Big variety of pictures. Yes, there are ads. But only between levels, no interruption during a level, and the ads can all be clicked out of very quickly. There are some comments saying that the pictures disappear instantly so you never get to see them…that is not true. Perhaps it was at one time, but now, between levels, the completed pictures run across the top and bottom of the screen, and you can look all you want…

I have no complaints about this game. It’s low key, relaxing, has a variety of difficulty levels. Not all the “pieces” are available at once, so you have to complete a picture in order to make room for more pieces to drop down. If you’re looking for an intellectual game that requires a lot of thought or logic or hard work, this isn’t it. If you’re looking for a game and you can just sit down and play immediately, no rush, no stress, no time limit, and you like jigsaw puzzle type games, you’re likely to enjoy this.
